text: {"lessons":["I sold several stocks after gains, but a gain relative to my cost is not by itself a reason to sell; I should decide using a consistent plan.","I should not let loss aversion or reluctance to admit a mistake keep me holding a position; assess it on its future merits, not my purchase price.","Daily attention can tempt me to overtrade, but past price moves do not predict future ones; I should avoid reacting to short-term fluctuations."]}
